# Kenney Nature Kit 2.1 — selected CC0 models

Creator: Kenney, https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit . See LICENSE.txt and
PROVENANCE.json for the pinned download mirror and checksums of original files.

Meshes/ contains native Unity Mesh assets converted from the 15 selected OBJ
models. Materials/ uses the existing project URP Lit shader, with warmer greens
for grass and leaves; the remaining MTL colors are retained. The source OBJ/MTL files are retained as text under Source/ to
avoid duplicate Unity model/material imports. Rename a copy back to .obj/.mtl
when editing in a DCC tool. Flat normals and material grouping are preserved.
These source files and derived meshes remain CC0; they are not team-authored art.
